# Contributor Licence Agreement

By contributing to Maschina you agree to the terms below. This exists for one
reason: so the project can keep the right to change its own licence later, and to
offer the software commercially, without having to track down every person who
has ever sent a patch.

Without it, every contributor holds copyright on their own lines, and one
unreachable contributor from four years ago can permanently freeze the project's
options.

You grant every recipient of the software the same rights.

You grant a patent licence covering any patent claims you own that your

infringes their patents.

You confirm that:

- The contribution is your original work, or you have the right to submit it.
- If your employer has rights to work you produce, you have permission to make

- Your contribution does not knowingly infringe anyone's rights.
- You are not required to provide support, and the contribution is provided

## How to sign

Reply on your pull request with exactly:

```
I have read the CLA and I agree to it.
```

Your signature is recorded in this repository. One signature covers every
contribution you make.

## A plain note

This is a standard agreement, adapted from ones used widely across the industry.
It is not legal advice and nobody involved is a lawyer. If you are contributing
on behalf of a company and your legal team wants something different, open an
issue and say so.
